notes: Chapter 11 after incorporation (GDD 7.8). Read by sim/restructuring.gd.

ownership_floor.note: CLAUDE.md: below 10% ownership the board replaces you and the act is lost.

dilution_base.note: Every restructuring cuts ownership by at least this share.

dilution_per_leverage.note: Extra cut scaled to how underwater the company is: debt divided by assets at fair value.

fleet_sold_fraction.note: Creditors sell this share of the fleet at used prices (GDD 7.8: some rigs are sold).

cure_days.note: GDD 7.7: a missed company payment starts a cure clock (auto-pause). Chapter 11 follows if the company is still short when it runs out.
